candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits tcp/443 from any source to fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2, and the ASA HTTP server is enabled globally on fw-01.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN permit for tcp/443 to 203.0.113.2 and restrict the ASA HTTP server to the mgmt interface and MGMT sources as the management policy requires.

candidates.claim: The VTY_MGMT permit entry for 10.10.99.0/24 on rtr-01 is modified from baseline sequence 10 to sequence 15.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change with the approved baseline by restoring sequence 10 or approving the new sequence number.

clarifications.question: rtr-01 has two static default routes, one via 198.51.100.1 (ISP) and one via 10.10.99.1 (fw-01 mgmt interface), and it has a connected MGMT interface Gi0 at 10.10.99.12. Is the default route via 10.10.99.1 intentional, and which route carries traffic toward OT or MGMT?
